## Test checklist

- [ ] Keyboard-only operation and logical focus order
- [ ] Visible focus indicators
- [ ] Heading levels and landmarks
- [ ] Accessible names and labels
- [ ] Focus management for panels/dialogs
- [ ] Screen reader announcement of status and new content
- [ ] Text and UI contrast
- [ ] Reflow at 320 CSS px and 200% zoom
- [ ] Reduced motion
- [ ] Error identification and recovery
- [ ] Touch target size and spacing

## Conformance statement

State precisely what was tested, what was not tested, and the evidence. Never claim full WCAG compliance based only on an automated scan.
